description: Manage ML training jobs for the UIForge sidecar model. Actions: check_readiness (verify training prerequisites), start_training (begin LoRA fine-tuning), get_status (check job progress), cancel_training (stop running job), list_adapters (show available adapters), get_summary (get training statistics).

action.description: Action to perform on the training system

adapter_name.description: Name of the adapter: quality-scorer, prompt-enhancer, or style-recommender

name: manage_training
